{{Top|leg}}
'''Ruik root''' was a chewable, bittersweet-tasting root. [[Kal Skirata]] was known to chew it on occasion after having taken a liking to it approximately one year after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].
